name: Define Task-triggered Project Director orchestration
description: Maintain and validate the governed Task and managed TRD for a future source-only revision of reusable Project Director orchestration assets in SKILLS-depo and ROLES-depo, while protecting the active Sys4AI root and deferring project adoption.
definition_of_done: A canonical project Task record governs this documentation-only objective and keeps Task state, the managed TRD, native-goal state, future source implementation, and later project adoption separate.

Managed TRD TRD-20260902-C2F3AF2B captures the requested Task definition, root Project Director activation and responsibilities, complexity assessment, direct and decomposed work, existing or reusable-role selection, adversarial solution agents, one-to-one review and revision loops, senior fusion and conflict recycling, implementation and completion ownership, and user orchestration overrides.

The TRD identifies SKILLS-depo/task/ and ROLES-depo/project-director-ROLE.md as required future source targets, treats SKILLS-depo/agent-task/ and SKILLS-depo/manage-subagent-roles/ as impact-analysis candidates, and excludes the active root ROLE.md and installed .agents/skills/ copies from implementation.

Every material user-intent statement maps to a requirement, decision, exclusion, or open question, every generated requirement has a source and observable acceptance criteria, and unresolved implementation ownership remains explicit rather than guessed.

The Task and TRD helpers validate their canonical artifacts and generated indexes without warnings, bidirectional traceability and dependency checks pass, and scoped evidence confirms this requirements revision did not modify reusable source assets or protected active copies.
current_summary: The original requirements Task is completed. All five documentation criteria have current artifact and validation evidence. Subsequent planning, source implementation, and project adoption Tasks are completed; PLAN-20260902-2C15FED4 is completed revision 84 and records the user-approved case-by-case ownership decision. TRD-20260902-C2F3AF2B remains separately managed at draft revision 7. Task completed. No next step required.
